proposal.reason: Main change is CE/DMA-backed host one-sided RMA (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal), including new RMA CE launch code, signal/ack synchronization, and large-transfer chunking. Add enqueue for substantive new API validation and conversion into planner/context queues plus RMA plan scheduling/launch wiring. Add device-api because public PCCL API/config surface and communicator/window semantics changed (new exported RMA calls, wait descriptors, hostRma capability reporting, and symmetric window/LSA offset validation behavior).
